# DeskTeam360
> DeskTeam360 runs the Office-Based Insourcing Model: dedicated teams in physical offices, North American account managers, a flat monthly rate, unlimited tasks, and no contracts. The team handles websites, development, automation, AI workflows, video, tech support, and design.

With the insourcing model, clients work with the same developers, technical Virtual Assistants, and designers every month. Every team member comes into the office to work. DeskTeam360 is built for owners of small digital or marketing agencies. That means about 1 to 5 people. The owner still does the client work. Service businesses use the same plans.

Key facts:
- Legal name: DeskTeam360
- Address: 2114 W Grant Rd, Tucson, AZ 85745
- Phone: +1 480-326-1440
- Email: Jeremy@DeskTeam360.com
- Founded in 2018 by Jeremy Kenerson, Founder and CEO.
- Over 400 businesses served since 2018.
- $2.5 million processed, zero chargebacks.
- Serves any US state, plus Canada, Australia, New Zealand, and the UK. Service is online only.
- Every plan includes a North American account manager, a team leader, 2 developers, 2 technical Virtual Assistants, 2 designers, and Jeremy on 2 weekly group calls.
- Most tasks ship in 1 to 3 business days.
- No contracts. Month to month. Cancel any time.
- 30-day money-back guarantee. Full refund within the first 30 days. No conditions.

Plans:
One flat monthly rate. Unlimited tasks. Unlimited revisions on every plan. Every plan covers every service. The only difference is how many tasks run at once. White label work is on all plans.
- Entrepreneur: $1,497 a month, 1 task at a time
- Marketer: $2,994 a month, 2 tasks at a time
- Agency: $4,491 a month, 3 tasks at a time
- Sold on their own, with no full plan needed: hosting at $29 a month and maintenance at $99 a month. Website maintenance is also included in every plan.

What the team does not do:
- It is not a replacement for a client's marketing strategist, business coach, or ads manager.
- Clients bring their own words. If a client helps train AI on their voice, the team can write for them.
- It does not manage ads. It sets up ad accounts and builds the ads. It does not monitor ads or conversions, and it does not make suggestions based on conversions. For that kind of help, clients can ask Jeremy on the weekly group calls.
- It does not reply to comments and DMs or manage an online community.
- It does not do link building, outreach, or domain authority work.
- It does not do complex 3D rendering or 3D modeling.

## Services
- [Websites and Development](https://deskteam360.com/services/web-design-development): WordPress, WooCommerce, landing pages, redesigns, bug fixes, custom features
- [Website Care and Tech Support](https://deskteam360.com/services/website-maintenance): WordPress core, plugin and theme updates, security monitoring, backups, uptime monitoring. Tech support: if a client can log into it, the team can help with it
- [CRM and Automation (GoHighLevel)](https://deskteam360.com/services/crm-automation): GoHighLevel CRM setup, pipelines and workflow automation; HubSpot, Zapier and Make builds
- [AI Workflows](https://deskteam360.com/services/ai-automation): AI chatbots, workflow automation builds, lead follow-up sequences
- [Email and Funnels](https://deskteam360.com/services/email-funnels): email campaign builds, automation sequences, GoHighLevel funnels, landing pages
- [Video Editing](https://deskteam360.com/services/video-editing): YouTube edits, short-form clips, webinar and course edits, ad cuts
- [Social Media Content](https://deskteam360.com/services/social-media-content): post graphics, story templates, cover graphics and thumbnails, delivered ready to schedule
- [Design](https://deskteam360.com/services/graphic-design): ad creatives, social graphics, logos, lead magnets, presentation decks

## Who it is for
- [Agencies](https://deskteam360.com/services/white-label): the team works under the agency's brand, and the DeskTeam360 name does not appear on the work
